description: A React component for editing access control rules via a table interface, parsing and generating CEL expressions, with support for user attributes, operators, and validation.

classes.name: TableEditor
classes.description: React component providing a table interface for constructing and editing CEL expressions based on user attributes.

methods.name: findFirstAvailableAttributeFromList
methods.description: Finds the first available user attribute that is safe and allowed for rule creation.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a CEL visual AST into a list of table rows for display and editing.
